title: Laser micro-cutting of tube
description: Laser micro-cutting of tube capability for titanium components
processDescription: Fiber laser cutting of titanium uses a focused 1 µm wavelength beam to melt and expel material through a coaxial assist gas jet. The narrow (0.1–0.3 mm) and small heat-affected zone make it suitable for precision profiles in sheet and thin-plate titanium components, specifically for tube. Micro tube for Chemical, Aerospace, Medical present unique challenges: Wall thickness uniformity (±0.05 mm) over long lengths. Internal surface finish Ra < 0.8 µm for fluid flow. Bent tube ovality control.
heatControl: Coaxial N₂ (99.999%) assist gas at 12–20 bar prevents titanium oxidation by displacing oxygen. Laser power modulation controls heat input to minimize HAZ to 0.05–0.15 mm.
flatnessControl: Thin-gauge titanium (< 2 mm) may release residual stress during cutting, causing distortion. Vacuum annealing stress relief at 540–650°C and roller leveling available.
capabilitiesDescription: Laser processing capability for Laser micro-cutting of tube, with precision beam delivery, gas assist systems, and process monitoring for repeatable quality.
